steps: Each replica hashes records into deterministic range leaves.

Different roots trigger comparison only down mismatching branches.
Exact divergent range is transferred and rehashed after repair.

production.scenario: Shopify inventory quantities are repaired between North America and Europe after warehouse feeds and replica drift diverge during a sale.
components: global ERP systems sending SKU quantity changes from multiple fulfillment regions
service boundary that validates SKU mutations before they reach the inventory domain
control-plane service that compares inventory digests and pinpoints divergent replica ranges
durable authority in Cassandra for per-SKU available-to-sell counts
uses repaired inventory state to place customer checkouts against healthy stock
repair path that schedules digest scans and range repair jobs between regions
observability path for divergent token ranges, repair duration, and stale checkout risk
flows: Warehouse systems post stock adjustments as orders, returns, and transfers land globally.
Validated stock deltas are written into the authoritative inventory keyspace.
The orchestrator asks the Merkle tree service to compare digest ranges for selected token slices.
Only mismatched ranges are queued against the authoritative store for repair streaming.
Order routing reads the repaired available quantity before admitting more carts.
The authority emits the rows needed to heal stale regional replicas for each divergent range.
Operators watch divergence hot spots, scan cost, and backlog to protect checkout accuracy.
